transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brings me in is that my sleep has gotten really messed up lately. I’ll, um, I'll either stay up half the night with my mind just running, or I end up waking up way too early feeling like I never even rested. So, yeah, I just really need to figure out what's going on with that.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest or not getting pleasure from things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Um, I actually stopped going to my salsa class recently. And my paints are still sitting out on the table at home, but... I don't know, I just look at them and feel nothing. It's almost like they belong to somebody else.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah, I have. Lately, I just wake up with this heavy, empty feeling. It's like... even just sitting in my own condo that I worked so hard for, it just makes me want to cry.
Have you been feeling guilty or like you’re not good enough lately?

Yeah, I have. Um... I just keep telling myself that I was really stupid to take on the mortgage for the condo. I feel like I've let everyone down somehow. And the thing is, no bill is actually late or anything. I mean, I look at numbers all day for work, so I know I'm paying everything on time. But I still just sit there feeling like I messed it all up and I'm just a failure.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you felt restless or fidgety lately?

Yeah, a bit of both, honestly. Like, at work, I'll just catch myself moving really slow. I'll just be sitting there, staring at the calculator for a while before I even press any of the buttons. But then other times, I'm just restless. I'll be fidgeting with receipts and I just can't seem to sit still in my chair.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, sure, but... nothing like this. This just feels different, like it's dragging on and on. So, no, I haven't really felt this way before.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping for more than two weeks at a time?

Um, like I just said, no, I really haven't. Even thinking about it being two weeks or more... no. I've never had a stretch where I felt this low or had trouble sleeping for that long before. This is definitely the first time it's ever dragged out like this.
Have you ever had any other times in your life, even before this, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping for more than a few days at a time?
No, really, I haven't. I know you keep asking, but I've never felt this way before, not even for a few days. This is all completely new to me.
Have you ever had any episodes in your life, even if they were brief, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping, even if it was just for a few days?
Look, I... I really don't know how else to say it. No. I haven't. Not for a few days, not for a week, not ever. This is the very first time anything like this has happened to me.

Have you ever experienced a time in your life when you felt so down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping that it significantly interfered with your daily life, even if it didn't last very long?

I... I feel like we're just going in circles now. Like I've been saying, no. I've never had anything like this mess with my daily life before. My work, my routine... it's always been fine until now. I really don't have a different answer for you, it's just never happened before this.
Have you ever, even once, felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping to any noticeable degree, even if it only lasted for a day or two and didn't interfere with your life?

I... no. I really don't know what else to tell you. I know you're trying to figure this out, but asking me again isn't going to change my answer. Not even for a day or two. Like I've been saying, I have never felt like this before in my life.
Can you think back through your life, maybe even in childhood or adolescence, if there was ever a time when you felt unusually sad or uninterested in things, even if it was very mild or short-lived?

Look, even... even thinking back to when I was a kid, or a teenager, the answer is still no. I was just a normal kid. I didn't go through any phases where I was unusually sad for no reason, or... or stopped caring about things. I really am trying to think back like you're asking, but there's just nothing there. This is all completely new.

Can you be absolutely sure that, even during times of stress or life changes, you never experienced even a short period—maybe just a few days—of feeling down, losing interest in things, or having trouble sleeping before this current episode?

I'm sure. I mean, of course I've had stressful times, everybody does, but I've never reacted like this. I didn't lose interest in my life or stop sleeping. I just dealt with the stress and moved on. I know you have to be thorough, but I really have never experienced anything like this before.
Can you confirm once again that you have never had any episode of depression, even very mild or brief, at any point in your life before this current episode?

Yes, I can confirm it again. I really have never had any kind of episode like this before now. I... I know you need to be absolutely sure, but I don't know how else to say it. This is the very first time I've ever dealt with anything like this.

Can you recall if you have ever had any other times in your life, even if they were very short or not as severe, when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping, even if it only lasted for a day or two?

I really don't know how else to answer this. No. Not even for a day or two. I mean, sure, everyone has a stressful day at work where they're just tired or frustrated, but that's just normal life. I've never had a time where I couldn't sleep or just stopped caring about things, even for a short bit. Like I keep saying, I really don't have anything else to tell you about that. This is the first time.

Can you confirm once again that you have never experienced a full-blown episode of depression, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping nearly every day for at least two weeks, at any point in your life before this current episode?

Yes, I can confirm it again. Like I've been saying, I really haven't ever gone through a two-week stretch of feeling down or not sleeping before all this started. I... I don't have a different answer for you. The answer is still no. This is definitely the first time.
